name: application
label: Application
css: .style-application { background: var(--slide-surface, #FFFFFF); background-image: radial-gradient(circle at 20% 50%, rgba(147, 51, 234, 0.08) 0%, transparent 50%), radial-gradient(circle at 80% 80%, rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.06) 0%, transparent 50%); position: relative; overflow: hidden; } .style-application::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(147, 51, 234, 0.02) 0%, transparent 100%); pointer-events: none; } .style-application .hook { font-size: 80px; font-weight: 900; color: var(--slide-text, #09090b); line-height: 1.1; letter-spacing: -0.02em; margin: 0; padding: 48px 48px 0; position: relative; z-index: 2; max-width: 90%; } .style-application .text { font-size: 50px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--slide-text, #09090b); line-height: 1.3; letter-spacing: -0.01em; margin: 16px 0 0; padding: 0 48px; position: relative; z-index: 2; max-width: 90%; } .style-application .step { font-size: 160px; font-weight: 900; color: rgba(147, 51, 234, 0.12); position: absolute; top: -40px; right: 24px; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: -0.02em; z-index: 1; } .style-application .brand { font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--slide-primary, #9333ea); position: absolute; bottom: 32px; left: 48px; z-index: 2; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; } .slide-code.style-application { background: var(--slide-surface-dark, #09090b); background-image: radial-gradient(circle at 20% 50%, rgba(147, 51, 234, 0.15) 0%, transparent 50%), radial-gradient(circle at 80% 80%, rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.12) 0%, transparent 50%); } .slide-code.style-application .hook, .slide-code.style-application .text { color: #FFFFFF; } .slide-code.style-application .step { color: rgba(147, 51, 234, 0.25); } .slide-code.style-application .brand { color: var(--slide-primary, #9333ea); } .slide-insight.style-application { background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(147, 51, 234, 0.95) 0%, rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.95) 100%); position: relative; overflow: hidden; } .slide-insight.style-application::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background-image: radial-gradient(circle at 30% 70%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1) 0%, transparent 50%), radial-gradient(circle at 70% 30%, rgba(147, 51, 234, 0.1) 0%, transparent 50%); pointer-events: none; } .slide-insight.style-application .hook { color: #FFFFFF; position: relative; z-index: 2; } .slide-insight.style-application .text { color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.95); position: relative; z-index: 2; } .slide-insight.style-application .step { color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15); } .slide-insight.style-application .brand { color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9); } .slide-insight.style-application .insight-text { font-size: 48px; font-weight: 600; color: #FFFFFF; line-height: 1.3; padding: 48px; position: relative; z-index: 2; max-width: 90%; letter-spacing: -0.01em; }
